LESSON: THE LOST SHEEP

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Teachings of Jesus Christ
Topic 4.2: The Lost Sheep

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Lost Sheep
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does the parable of the lost sheep portray God’s love for the sinner?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the parable of the lost sheep

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the parable of the lost sheep

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the parable of the lost sheep.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe the parable of the lost sheep” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe the parable of the lost sheep” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe the parable of the lost sheep" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the parable of the lost sheep

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the parable of the lost sheep

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for The Lost Sheep.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does the parable of the lost sheep portray God’s love for the sinner?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the parable of the lost sheep

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
